stock.description: EDA Group Holdings Limited provides end-to-end supply chain solutions specifically designed for the e-commerce sector. The company has a global presence, serving markets in the People's Republic of China, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, and Australia. Its comprehensive service portfolio includes logistics management, warehousing facilities, international freight transportation, and efficient order fulfillment. The firm was established in 2014 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
